title: An explicit periodic signing of C_n(1,2) below the conjectured minimum
abstract: The paper's disproof of Suvagiya's signed-circulant minimum conjecture on an infinite arithmetic progression, formalized at the matrix level. For every n divisible by 8, Lean defines the paper's period-8 triangle-flux signing of the circulant graph C_n(1,2) as an explicit signed adjacency matrix, proves it is a plus-minus-one signing of mathlib's circulant graph, and proves by exact rational sum-of-squares window certificates that every eigenvalue has absolute value at most 1397/500. For every n >= 32 this rational separator lies strictly below the conjectured minimum rho_-(n) = 2*sqrt(cos^2(pi/n)+cos^2(2pi/n)), so the conjectured value is beaten by an explicit signing on all of n = 0 mod 8, n >= 32. The full Bloch determinant identity and the all-phase algebraic band-edge certificate remain selected as the supporting layer.
